label: NexusAI
text: NexusAI is Nagendra's flagship internal enterprise AI platform, developed from October 2023 to the present for HR, Finance, IT, and Operations teams. It provides secure, citation-grounded organizational knowledge access and approval-controlled business workflow automation through asynchronous Python and FastAPI services with Pydantic, AsyncIO, SQLite, and SQLAlchemy persistence.

label: NexusAI
text: NexusAI uses a multi-source Hybrid RAG pipeline combining ChromaDB dense vector retrieval, BM25 sparse keyword search, retrieval fusion, deterministic reranking, OCR, and verified citations. Ingestion supports PDFs, scanned documents, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, web pages, and approved SQL data sources. SharePoint, Google Drive, Confluence, Slack, and Microsoft Teams connectors use incremental synchronization, retry handling, and change tracking.

label: NexusAI
text: A LangGraph supervisor in NexusAI coordinates Research, Planning, Risk Policy, Execution, Verification, and Reporting agents through typed handoffs. Before MCP-based external tool execution, the platform enforces risk classification, human approval, and separation of duties. Security controls include JWT authentication, Argon2 password hashing, multi-tenant RBAC, source and workflow ACLs, prompt-injection detection, PII redaction, and audit logging.

label: NexusAI
text: NexusAI includes React and TypeScript dashboards for knowledge search, workflow approvals, evaluations, security administration, and monitoring. Prometheus and Grafana provide operational instrumentation. Critical workflows were validated with 121 automated backend tests and Playwright browser smoke tests.

label: TAG
text: Test Automation Generator, or TAG, is Nagendra's flagship Generative AI project: an enterprise platform that ingests requirements from Jira, VersionOne, Excel, BRD, FRD, and SRS documents, then produces validated, enriched, and automation-ready QA artifacts through orchestrated AI workflows.

label: TAG
text: TAG uses asynchronous FastAPI services, LangChain, and a stateful LangGraph workflow for requirement validation, enhancement, planning, test-case generation, and Selenium script generation. PostgreSQL and Async SQLAlchemy store versioned artifacts, while WebSockets stream real-time workflow progress.

label: TAG
text: Nagendra's LangGraph experience includes modeling multi-stage AI work as explicit workflow state with validation, enrichment, planning, test generation, automation generation, checkpoints, and human-review boundaries. His broader Generative AI skill set includes RAG, LangChain, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Groq, Hugging Face, and prompt engineering.

label: IVACS
text: IVACS is an enterprise voice automation platform for appointment scheduling, customer verification, IVR routing, and customer workflows. It connects Amazon Connect and Lex to AWS Lambda and FastAPI business services, RDS and enterprise systems, with CloudWatch, S3, Athena, Glue, and Comprehend for monitoring and analytics.

label: E-Commerce
text: Nagendra built e-commerce APIs and automation integrating Shopify, Django REST Framework, Flask, SQLAlchemy, Selenium, and Scrapy. He containerized services and supported GCP migration using Cloud Run, App Engine, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub.
